summary: Web preview, frontend only, QA learner read-only (no write ever reached the website: every non-GET under /api/jl outside /auth was stopped and counted = 0; door PUTs, display_name and busy parts answered in the test browser only). A NAME: PASS. Real answer -> Home 'good evening, learner.', Account 'Learner'. With display_name 'Asha Rao' -> Home ', asha.', Account 'Asha Rao' (the app server copy GET /api/rf/name is empty for this account). With the app server copy answered as 'Ravi Kumar' in the browser, Account shows 'Ravi Kumar' (its copy wins) and Home still says ', asha.'. With display_name null it goes back to 'learner' / 'Learner'. B MERI DETAILS: B1 (real website, 404) PASS: exactly one GET -> 404, 'rank.details.door' stamped, no further request on tab reopen or reload, Save 180 -> '180 marks', Cut off and College predictor forms and screens prefilled 180, no PUT, hatao -> 'Add details'. B2 PASS (222 marks · OBC-NCL | BITSAT: 301, tools filled, one GET). B3 FAILS as the request is written: Edit -> 199 -> Save sends only a GET and NO PUT, and the bar quietly goes back to 222 while 'Save ho gaya' is shown. Cause: the account copy's at (now+60 s) is later than the save's at = Date.now(). With an account copy older than the save, B3 passes (GET then PUT {rank_details.jee.marks '199', at newer}, no uid/clearedAt in the body). B4 passes in the same setup (PUT rank_details null + at; still 'Add details' after reload). B5 PASS (GET at 0 -> PUT of the phone's 150). B6 PASS (garbage 'x' -> nothing changes, no PUT). B7 PASS (signed out, /rank sends you to /entry and no door request is made). C PICTURES PASS: the chapter-test result 91e7b6bf uses parts (links ?look=cut&format=webp + ?kind=solution, 27 CDN parts) and has 394 copies in IndexedDB after 30 s. PYQ c0061f81: only 2 copies; its pack fallback was asked at ~22 s (the website's vault, not a regression). Retry-After 2 (CDN part 0 and pack offset=0 both 503 once): part 0 is asked again 2.0 s later, gets 200, 394 pictures. Retry-After 60: no second ask, pictures still arrive (82 asked one by one). D REGRESSION PASS: offline_rapid_check small 33/33, offline_papers_check small 37/37 (6 whole, 5 PYQ without pictures because the website gives none), class_name_check small 30/30 (Physics 15/15, Chemistry 11/12 + Other 1, Mathematics 17/10). No red screens.

ui_bugs.component: Meri details save vs account copy (src/rank/profileSync.ts:41-45 + src/rank/profile.ts:109)
ui_bugs.issue: An explicit Save (or hatao) is overwritten by the account's copy whenever that copy's `at` is later than the phone's Date.now(). This happens with clock skew between devices, or with the B2 stand-in at now+60 s. saveProfile stamps at=Date.now(), then syncProfile(true) GETs first. Because remoteAt > localAt it calls takeProfile(remote): the typed 199 turns back into 222, no PUT is sent, and the screen still says 'Save ho gaya'. Reproduced twice (tests/iter154_name_rank_door.py B3/B4, tests/iter154_followup.py B3-skew).

issues: Opened straight by URL, account-name first shows 'Practice profile' until the stored user is read (seen once, read straight after load). Opened from Home it shows 'Learner'. A small flash that was probably there before.

action_items: Fix: a user's explicit Save or 'Meri details hatao' must win over the account copy it has already seen. One way: keep the last remote `at` seen in profileSync and stamp saves/clears with at = max(Date.now(), lastRemoteAt + 1). Another: for syncProfile(true) after a user action, skip the remote-newer check and PUT straight away. Then re-run B3 with the account copy at now+60 s: a PUT with jee.marks '199' and at > the copy's at, and the bar keeps 199.
critical_code_review_comments: paperPack.ts cdnPart reads Retry-After from a cross-origin CDN response. On web, Retry-After is not a CORS-safelisted header, so the CDN must send Access-Control-Expose-Headers: Retry-After or the value reads as null. Today the same-origin pack fallback's own 503 + Retry-After covers this (tested: retry still happened without the expose header). But a CDN 503 followed by a non-503 pack failure would not be retried on web. Native is not affected.

loadPack part(): when the CDN and the pack both 503, the wait used is busyWait(packError) || cdnBusy. A pack Retry-After of 60 s (ignored) plus a CDN Retry-After of 2 s still retries after 2 s. This is acceptable, but note it.

profileSync: the Rank tab's ProfileBar calls syncProfile only on mount. If the session/asset account is not set yet at mount (cold start straight onto Rank), there is no sync until the tab is mounted again. Minor.
The PUT body is clean: only {rank_details:{at,jee,comedk,bitsat}|null, at}. uid and clearedAt are not sent.

success_rate.frontend: app checks 37/39 (95%) + regression 100/100; the 2 failures are one bug (save lost against a newer-dated account copy)

seed_data_creation: None. Nothing was written to the website or Mongo. Only the test browser's own localStorage/IndexedDB changed, and those contexts were thrown away.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run scripts with /usr/bin/chromium (the Playwright bundled shell is missing). tests/iter154_name_rank_door.py runs A+B in one sign-in (~3 min). tests/iter154_followup.py covers B3/B4 with a stand-in door that stores PUTs, including the clock-skew case. tests/iter154_pictures_busy.py runs 6 fresh contexts (~5 min): it counts IndexedDB 'jeelive-private-images-v1'.images, because the Analysis view shows no pictures. The links answer order (question vs solution) races, so 'part 0' may be either kind's part. A direct page.goto('/account') shows 'Practice profile' for a moment: open Account via home-account-button and wait ~4 s.
rca_of_issue: B3 failure: ProfileForm.save -> saveProfile (at=Date.now()) -> syncProfile(true) -> GET door -> remoteAt (now+60000) > localAt -> takeProfile(remote) brings 222 back and returns before the PUT. Repro: answer GET /api/jl/profile/rank-details with rank_details at = Date.now()+60000, open Rank, Edit -> 199 -> Save: no PUT and the bar shows 222. Mitigation: see action_items.
